استعطروا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْطَرُوا (istaʕṭarū) /is.taʕ.tˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَعْطَرَ (istaʕṭara)
# اِسْتَعْطِرُوا (istaʕṭirū) /is.taʕ.tˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْطَرَ (istaʕṭara)
